title.zh: 将南甘马粦省拉戈诺伊市镇圣塞巴斯蒂安描笼涯San Sebastian渔业中学的名称变更为San Sebastian国立中学的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of San Sebastian Fisheries High School in Barangay San Sebastian, Municipality of Lagonoy, Province of Camarines Sur to San Sebastian National High School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of San Sebastian Fisheries High School in Barangay San Sebastian, Municipality of Lagonoy, Province of Camarines Sur to San Sebastian National High School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Trường Trung học Thủy sản San Sebastian tại Barangay San Sebastian, Đô thị Lagonoy, Tỉnh Camarines Sur thành Trường Trung học San Sebastian Quốc gia
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาประมง San Sebastian ในบารังไกย์ San Sebastian เทศบาล Lagonoy จังหวัด Camarines Sur เป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา San Sebastian แห่งชาติ
title.id: Undang-Undang Mengubah Nama Sekolah Menengah Perikanan San Sebastian di Barangay San Sebastian, Kotamadya Lagonoy, Provinsi Camarines Sur menjadi Sekolah Menengah San Sebastian Nasional
title.ms: Akta Menukar Nama Sekolah Menengah Perikanan San Sebastian di Barangay San Sebastian, Perbandaran Lagonoy, Wilayah Camarines Sur kepada Sekolah Menengah San Sebastian Kebangsaan

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2024/ra_12085_2024.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of San Sebastian Fisheries High School in Barangay San Sebastian, Municipality of Lagonoy, Province of Camarines Sur is hereby changed to San Sebastian National High School.
This Act shall take effect after fifteen (15) days following its publication in the Official Gazette or in a national newspaper of general circulation.
